Name: Penguins instead of chickens - Content Patcher (CP)
Author: AnnaAbramek
Description:
This mod replaces chickens in the game with penguins.

[b]Chickens are replaced in a following way:[/b]
White chicken - Adelie penguin
Brown chicken - Galapagos penguin
Blue chicken - Emperor penguin
Void chicken - Chinstrap penguin
Golden chicken - Gentoo penguin


[size=5][b]Requirements:[/b][/size]
To use this mod you need:
- [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915?tab=description]Content Patcher[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10232?tab=description]Sound Effect Replacement[/url]


[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

This mod works with many mods editing game code, such as Automate, Non destructive NPCs, Chests anywhere and with most of Content Patcher packs.

It [b]doesn't work[/b] properly with mods that edit text files containing information refering to chickens. This includes mods that replace livestock animals with different ones. [b]Mods that only change sprites should work fine.

[/b]
